verdict.rationale: The hosted platform lets users download the models they train (docs-10) and offers 2-bit exports (docs-3). An open-source package also supports local fine-tuning on your own hardware and data, which reduces lock-in (docs-2, docs-1). There is no evidence of a full account-data export, and the export formats are not stated as open. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all user data (uploaded datasets, generated training data, job history), explicit open-format guarantees for exported models and data, account deletion/offboarding docs, independent confirmation of export working.
